question: Show violation counts by type for the last 6 months.
text: There were 375 reports of pest evidence, 321 reports of water damage or mold, and 311 reports of damaged surfaces in the last 6 months. Other notable violation types include leak plumbing (254) and smoke detector missing (177). The most common violation was pest evidence, while no heat was the least frequent with 56 reports.
sql:
SELECT reports.violation_type, COUNT(*) AS violation_count
FROM fixit.gold.reports
WHERE reports.reported_at >= dateadd(MONTH, -6, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND reports.violation_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY reports.violation_type
ORDER BY violation_count DESC
